CONCILIATION ORDER
The Miscellaneous First Appeal No. 5066/2017 filed by the appellants - claimants for enhancement.

The respondent - National Insurance Company filed M.F.A. No.
6863/2017 for setting aside the Judgment and Award passed by the Claims Tribunal.
2. After prolonged negotiations, the matter is settled.

A joint memo signed by the learned advocate appearing for the appellants/claimants (being authorized by the appellants/claimants to sign) and the learned advocate appearing for the respondent-Insurance Company and its authorized officer is filed.

The appellants - claimants have agreed to receive and the respondent - Insurance Company has agreed to pay a lump-sum compensation of Rs.15,90,000/- (Rupees Fifteen Lakhs Ninety Thousand only) in addition to the compensation awarded by the Claims Tribunal.

The respondent - Insurance Company has already deposited a sum of Rs.4,24,000/- with accrued interest before this Court in M.F.A. No. 6863/2017 apart from the settlement arrived at between the parties (i.e.
Rs.15,90,000/-), in full and final settlement of the claim.

4. The Respondent - Insurance Company has agreed to deposit the said amount (Rs.15,90,000/-)
before the Tribunal within six weeks from the date of preparation of award, failing which the said amount shall carry interest at the rate of 9% P.A. from the date of default, till the date of deposit.
The amount if any with accrued interest (in MFA No.6863/2017), deposited before this Court shall be transferred to the Claims Tribunal forthwith.
5. The apportionment, deposit and release of the modified compensation amount and also the amount in deposit shall be made in terms of the Judgment and Award passed by the Claims Tribunal.
6. Accordingly, M.F.A. No.5066/2017 filed by the appellants - claimants is allowed in part in terms of the Joint memo.
The Judgment and Award of the Tribunal shall stand modified accordingly.

In view of the settlement arrived at between the parties in M.F.A. No.5066/2017, the connected M.F.A.
No.6863/2017 has been withdrawn by the respondent - Insurance Company as not pressed.
Draw up the Award accordingly.

Sd/-
JUDGE Sd/-
